launch_hidden_states_server: launch an sgl Server with --enable-return-hidden-states for a given model path
wait_for_server_ready: wait for the sgl Server HTTP endpoint to become ready before sending requests
generate_with_hidden_states: send prompts to the sgl Server /generate endpoint with return_hidden_states enabled
terminate_server_process: terminate the sgl Server background process after completing requests
convert_and_concat_hidden_states: convert hidden state lists to torch bfloat16 tensors and concatenate along batch dimension
